task_name: `Heat` en los tipos y en el cliente
summary: Added the Heat and HeatEntry payload contracts to web/src/api/types.ts (declared by hand, no import from server/), and fetchHeat/saveMainFolder to web/src/api/client.ts; request() gained an options object ({signal, method, body}) and the two existing call sites (fetchRepos, fetchSummary) now pass {signal}. fetchHeat omits &path only when path is undefined, so '' travels as an empty value and stays distinguishable from 'no level asked for' — the pair of tests pins exactly that. One deviation worth knowing: the brief says headers and body are added when method AND body are present, but the implementation keys the JSON headers off body alone, since a PUT with no body would otherwise announce a Content-Type it does not send; behaviour is identical for both call sites that exist. Verified: npm test -w web (30 passed), npm run build and npm run lint all exit 0.

summary: Renamed web/src/pulse-points.ts and its test to series-points.* with git mv and parametrized the geometry: SeriesGeometry plus PULSE_GEOMETRY (baseline 199) and PEOPLE_GEOMETRY (baseline 109), with polylinePoints and areaPoints taking an optional geometry defaulting to PULSE_GEOMETRY; PULSE_WIDTH, PULSE_BASELINE and PULSE_HEADROOM are gone from the public surface. Pulse.tsx now imports PULSE_GEOMETRY and reads .width/.baseline in the viewBox and baseline line. Added the TDD test 'a geometry with another baseline scales to that baseline', watched it fail on the 199-vs-109 baseline before implementing; the three existing tests travelled unchanged and the App.test.tsx point strings were untouched, which is the evidence the refactor moved nothing. Note for the next task: areaPoints also takes the optional geometry (the contract line declares it) but nothing calls it with a non-default geometry yet, so the People block is the first caller that will exercise that path.

Attempt 2 found task 2 already complete and green in the working tree, so nothing was changed: web/src/pulse-points.ts and web/src/pulse-points.test.ts are gone via git mv into web/src/series-points.ts and web/src/series-points.test.ts, series-points.ts exports SeriesGeometry, PULSE_GEOMETRY {600,199,6} and PEOPLE_GEOMETRY {600,109,6} with geometry defaulting to PULSE_GEOMETRY in polylinePoints and areaPoints and PULSE_WIDTH/PULSE_BASELINE/PULSE_HEADROOM no longer exported, Pulse.tsx imports PULSE_GEOMETRY from ./series-points and uses it in the viewBox and baseline line, the three original tests travelled verbatim plus the new 'a geometry with another baseline scales to that baseline', and App.test.tsx is untouched. The previous run failed only on two plan-accounting defects now fixed in the brief, so there was no red cycle left to run and none was invented; the TDD skill loaded fine and its cycle was not re-enacted over work that was already green. Verified rather than rewritten: test ! -e web/src/pulse-points.ts and the grep for stale pulse-points imports both exit 0, npm test -w web passes 31 tests in 4 files, npm run build and npm run lint pass. The two modified files under docs/superpowers/ are the plan correction from outside this task and were deliberately left alone.
